title: With These Hands
lyrics:
[Intro - Spoken low, building]
En San Juan, bajo el sol que quema...
Las manos que sueñan, las manos que crean...

[Verse 1]
From the dust of the courts to the dreams in the street
Every swing is a story, every point is a beat
Palmera rising, Rivas calling loud
200 players strong, making the whole town proud
With these hands we build, with these hands we fight
No cold in the blood, only fire and light

[Pre-Chorus]
Dembow in the veins, Spanglish on the tongue
Nicaragua sound, the new chapter's begun

[Chorus - Big, anthemic, crowd vocals]
With these hands! (¡Con estas manos!)
We rise up tall! (¡Nos levantamos!)
Pickleball fire burning in our soul
From Managua to the sea, we play it whole
With these hands! We claim the game
Palmera Pickleball, remember the name
336 in the rhythm, signal stays true
This is our court — this is for you!

[Verse 2 - Spanish/Spanglish]
En las calles de Tola, en Rancho Santana
Los jóvenes sueñan, la comunidad se levanta
Con raqueta en mano y el corazón en paz
Construimos futuro, sin mirar atrás
¡Dembow! ¡Fuerza! ¡Pasión!
Nicaragua pickleball — ¡esta es nuestra canción!

[Bridge - Half-time, emotional build]
Hard work in the blood, curiosity in the eyes
Surprise in every rally, under these skies
No borders on the court, only connection and grace
This is the movement — this is our place

[Final Chorus - Full power, layered vocals]
With these hands! (¡Con estas manos!)
We rise up tall! (¡Nos levantamos!)
336 signal humming through the night
Palmera family — we own the light
With these hands we sing, with these hands we play
Nicaragua pickleball — ¡vamos pa' la cima hoy!
